title: OJ load test - full 0/1 knapsack v2
content: Choose each of n items at most once to maximize total value with total weight <= W. Input: n W followed by n lines of weight value. Output: maximum total value. 1 <= n <= 2000, 1 <= W <= 20000, 1 <= weight <= 20001, 1 <= value <= 10000. Twenty test cases, including boundary and full-size cases.
answer: O(nW) descending-capacity dynamic programming; O(W) space.
